description: Decodes a TAF terminal aerodrome forecast into plain-English periods (initial, FM, BECMG, TEMPO, PROB) with the forecast flight category of each. Pass the raw TAF text or a 4-letter ICAO code to fetch the current TAF from NOAA's Aviation Weather Center. For training, not for flight planning.

icao.description: ICAO airport code, e.g. KORD. Used when taf is not given.

taf.description: Raw TAF text, starting with 'TAF' or the station code.

name: decode_taf
title: Decode a TAF
